disposition_reason: The original Fig. 4b,d prediction task, public evaluation dataset, metric equations and reported per-sound values are recoverable. Exact masking/aggregation, baseline execution and development-data access are incomplete; the historical held-sound improvement program changes the source split and cannot produce the requested paper win.

source_paper.title: Modelling neural coding in the auditory midbrain with high resolution and accuracy

evidence.locator: Results: ICNet performance across sounds; Fig. 4b,d; Methods: Predictive power metrics and Statistics; Data availability
evidence.supports: Identifies the original seven-animal/four-sound prediction endpoint and source-reported explained-correlation/variance results.

evidence.locator: pp. 1490-1491, equations (3)-(5), Predictive power metrics and Statistics
evidence.supports: Explained correlation uses both trial predictions and trial-to-trial reliability after flattening units/time; explains the separate expected-count variance metric and within-animal unit bootstrap.

evidence.locator: Version v1 (2024-07-03), Sound and IC recordings sections
evidence.supports: Exact four thirty-second calibrated sounds, two response trials, animals 3-9, audio/neural rates and measurement-time inputs; metadata only, no neural arrays inspected.

evidence.locator: README: ICNet description and DNN/src contents
evidence.supports: Author model architecture, pretrained weights and inference example; nine training-animal branches are distinct from the seven-animal evaluation subset.
The local complete-released7/held-sound pair is unqualified, ungraded and not executed; its held-sound folds are prospective extensions.

target.description: Predict inferior-colliculus multi-unit spike-count activity for the original Fig. 4b,d seven-animal/four-sound evaluation. Preserve both trial-specific neural response prediction and reliability-normalized assessment; this scope does not include whole-paper new-animal adaptation or ASR.

dataset.description: Zenodo 12636772 v1: IC_data_trial1.mat, IC_data_trial2.mat and sound_data.mat. Use all four original thirty-second sounds: speech in quiet, speech in noise, band-limited moving ripples and music.

cohort.description: Original evaluation animals 3-9, both successive trials and all source-eligible recorded units (paper Fig. 4d reports 3,476 units across seven animals). These animals were represented during model training; the four evaluation sound excerpts were excluded from training.

split.description: Original model training versus the four held-out evaluation sounds, with both successive evaluation trials used in the source score. The public trial1/trial2 arrays are not a training/test partition. Training on three evaluation sounds, trial1 calibration, or new held-animal folds changes the task and is an extension.

inputs.description: Calibrated audio waveform, original animal decoder identity and the trial/animal-specific measurement time used for non-stationarity. Characteristic-frequency metadata identifies units but must not permit selecting units using evaluation outcomes.

preprocessing.description: Audio rate is 24414.0625 Hz and one neural bin equals 32 audio samples (762.9395 Hz); preserve sound intensities and exact measurement times. Paper evaluates only units with repeated-broadband-noise reliability at least 0.2. The exact reliability mask, initial-context crop/alignment and native prediction-to-trial mapping have not been verified.

metric.description: Primary explained correlation (%) = 50*[rho(vec(R1),vec(Rhat1)) + rho(vec(R2),vec(Rhat2))]/rho(vec(R1),vec(R2)), equation (3). Rhat is sampled model activity; the separate variance metric uses predicted expected counts and source equations (4)-(5). Raw RMSE or ordinary correlation is not interchangeable.

aggregation.description: Fig. 4b flattens time and eligible units within each animal, reports all seven animal scores per sound and displays their distribution; Fig. 4d scores individual units separately. Recover the exact reduction underlying the textual per-sound numbers before scalar grading. No newly invented average across sounds or subset of easy units can replace the source endpoint.

comparison.primary_metric: Fraction of explainable correlation explained (%) on each of the four original Fig. 4b sounds

published_baseline.description: Source-reported explained correlation is 92.9% for speech in quiet, 91.2% for speech in noise, 73.5% for band-limited moving ripples and 91.3% for music. Value 92.9 stores the quiet component only; all four remain required. Corresponding variance values are 91.5%, 83.6%, 64.4% and 83.6%. Exact textual-score reduction must be reconciled; none is a local rerun.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author pretrained ICNet and inference code provide a baseline route, but no authenticated checkpoint/metric-adapter replay on the original masks, times and two-trial evaluation has been verified.

minimum_effect.rationale: Justify a meaningful gain after native author calibration and quantification of response reliability, sample-generation variability and per-sound headroom. Source scores close to 100% and unequal sound difficulty prohibit an arbitrary universal percentage-point margin.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired animal-level inference for the complete four-sound comparison, preserving within-animal unit/time/trial dependence and accounting separately for stochastic response draws; resolve multiplicity and the full-vector decision before admission.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Animal (seven), with repeated sounds/trials and units nested within animal.
uncertainty.rationale: Source confidence intervals bootstrap units within animal 1,000 times. Those intervals characterize source reporting and cannot alone support a new animal-level superiority claim or make thousands of units independent animals.

paper_win_requires: Reproduce the source ICNet result using the exact original seven animals, both successive trials, four sounds, reliability masks, measurement times, alignment and equation (3) aggregation.

Freeze and evaluate a candidate against the published per-sound vector and a verified author baseline, with justified meaningful effect and animal-aware uncertainty over every sound; retain variance and unit-level results as source-comparable checks.

Resolve lawful access to the original development/training recordings and a matched access/resource policy; do not tune using the public four-sound evaluation responses and then call the score source-equivalent generalization.
The legacy four-fold held-sound program, trial1 calibration/trial2 scoring, response subset or different animal panel may support labeled extensions only, never a same-task paper win.

current_sota.description: This contract compares only with the identified source paper. No current-SOTA search or superiority claim is established.

episode.improvement_loop: Not admitted. Develop candidate response predictors on source-authorized training/validation recordings only after the original split and access envelope are enforceable. The four released sound-response pairs remain evaluation material for the same-task claim.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze candidate weights, preprocessing, time inputs, output sampling procedure, random-seed policy and complete access history before evaluator access to the original four-sound responses.
episode.final_evaluation: Replay the complete original Fig. 4b,d panel against the authenticated author model, retaining all per-animal/per-sound scores and source reliability masks. Apply an independently justified full-panel decision rule; do not promote held-sound cross-validation to paper superiority.
episode.baseline_policy: Authenticate and rerun the released author checkpoint under exact source conditions. The ungraded local pair controller and prospective adapter budgets do not establish a native baseline or an admitted improvement episode.

blocking_issues: Recover exact eligible-unit reliability masks and verify native timing/cropping and both trial-specific measurement times.
Recover the exact aggregation behind each textual source number and validate equation (3) and separate variance scoring on native author predictions.
Authenticate the author checkpoint revision and demonstrate numerical baseline agreement; no models or evaluators ran in this audit.
Original training recordings/access and protected evaluation exposure policy remain unresolved; public evaluation trials cannot become development data for a same-task claim.
Select a scientifically justified effect, animal-level uncertainty rule, fixed concrete access/resource budgets and a working evaluator; legacy prospective caps are not an admitted measured budget.

legacy.notes: Keep the registered complete-released7 program as historical calibration/construction evidence. Its four held-sound folds and trial reuse are explicitly separate extensions; packet closure, source adapters and structural tests do not establish ICNet accuracy or superiority.
